name: Store RAG Pattern
description: Store text/JSON data to RAG Vector Store
explanation:
Pattern for storing data to RAG Vector Store.

Store node:
- type: 'custom' (standard node)
- nodeType: 'store'
- color: 'bg-emerald-500'

Key settings:
- content: Text/template to store (supports {{variables}})
- documentIdMode: 'auto' or 'template'
- documentIdTemplate: Custom ID (when mode is 'template')
- customMetadata: [{key, value}] for metadata

Template variables in content:
- {{context.xxx}}: Context variables
- {{message}}: User message
- {{aiResponse}}: AI response
- {{httpResult}}: HTTP result (JSON)
- {{httpResult.xxx}}: Specific fields

Result: context.storeResult
- { success, provider, documentCount, documentIds, error }

RAG Providers (auto-detected from Settings):
- openai_vector_store: OpenAI Vector Store
- pinecone: Pinecone (with chunking)
- gemini_file_search: Gemini Files API

Note: Store is for WRITING to RAG.
For READING (retrieval), use Source RAG pattern.
